notes: Dev testing works again: the browser now starts on Node 20 directly, and the app checks it at run start. If it cannot start, the run shows the real error.
New run buttons: Reconnect browser, and a Read-only DB switch. Both restart the run in the same session, so nothing already found is lost.
Strict read-only no longer blocks ordinary code edits, such as the <mssql> query files.
New Product knowledge toggle: runs search the WeKnora PeoplesHR docs (PRDs, behaviour briefs, findings) while analysing.
Fixed: replies to a reopened run showed twice; "moved from X to X" state notes are gone.
Also includes 2.23.2: settings files saved with a BOM no longer turn Superpower off.
